note: Adapted from the species description in Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the number of antennal segments of the alate is not preserved in the source, so only the comparison of segment lengths is recorded. Synonymy, literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are not translated.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule brown with a smoky tinge, fontanelle gland area paler; nasus slightly darker than the head; antennae light brown; thorax light brown; abdominal tergites darker than the thorax; legs and sternites pale yellow. Head bare; nasus with a few setae at the apex; anterior margin of the pronotum with many microscopic setae, with a few others elsewhere on the body; abdominal tergites without long setae, the posterior tergites with a few microscopic setae; sternites densely covered with short and long setae. Body length 3.0–4.50 mm. Head capsule pear-shaped without the nasus; sides markedly narrowed anteriorly (length with nasus 1.60–1.65, length without nasus 0.87–1.05, width 0.90–1.0 mm); in lateral view markedly incurved, nasus hump absent. Nasus long, cylindrical (length 0.60 mm, nasus length/head length index 0.57–0.60). Antennae 13-segmented; segment 3 almost twice as long as segment 2, also recorded as one and a half times or nearly equal to segment 2. Mandibles reduced, each with a short spine-like process. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.25, width 0.50 mm); anterior margin without a notch, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule deep straw-coloured; antennae, labrum and postclypeus pale yellow; pronotum paler than the head; legs and sternites cream-coloured, abdominal tergites brown. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 4.25–5.0 mm. Head capsule broadly oval, length to the base of the mandibles equal to the maximum width (head width 1.33). Cranial sutures distinct and broad. Fontanelle plate large, nearly oval, white, not narrow and elongate as in other Indian species. Antennae 15-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3, segment 3 equal to or slightly longer than segment 4. Postclypeus swollen, hairy; less than half as long as wide. Pronotum saddle-shaped (width 0.72 mm); anterior margin without a notch.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head brown, red-yellow around and in front of the fontanelle plate; fontanelle plate white; postclypeus brightly coloured; pronotum paler than the head; wings brownish; abdominal tergites brown, sternites and legs red-yellow. Head and thorax densely hairy; wings with dense fine setae. Body length with wings 14.50 mm, without wings 5.50 mm. Head wider than long (length to the apex of the labrum 1.35, head width including eyes 1.44 mm). Fontanelle plate large, oval, white. Eyes large, markedly projecting. Ocelli oval; separated from the compound eyes by about their long diameter. Number of antennal segments not preserved in the source; segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 slightly shorter than segment 2. Postclypeus not strongly swollen, less than half as long as wide; anterior margin straight, posterior margin convex. Pronotum trapezoidal, anterior and posterior margins straight (length 0.65, width 1.10 mm). Wings brownish, hairy; fore wing length 11.5 mm.
